changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE nexus.request_ledger ( tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, request_id UUID NOT NULL, route TEXT NOT NULL, body_sha256 BYTEA NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL, holder UUID, lease_until TIMESTAMPTZ, started_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, finished_at TIMESTAMPTZ, response_status INTEGER, response JSONB, CONSTRAINT request_ledger_pk PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, request_id), CONSTRAINT request_ledger_body_sha256_len CHECK (octet_length(body_sha256) = 32), CONSTRAINT request_ledger_state_check CHECK (state IN ('in_flight', 'committed', 'failed')) );
-- Live-lease reads and the expired in_flight retention delete. CREATE INDEX idx_request_ledger_lease ON nexus.request_ledger (tenant_id, state, lease_until); -- The terminal-row retention delete. CREATE INDEX idx_request_ledger_finished ON nexus.request_ledger (tenant_id, finished_at);
changeSet.rollback: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS nexus.request_ledger CASCADE
